summary: A small task from a blank file that mixes the week: the split from Day 25, a decision tree with one setting to choose (max_depth), and one honest look at the test pile. You also see a one-line rule beat the tree.
goal: Train a small model, choose its setting with validation, and report the test accuracy once, from a blank file.

items.text: Answer the two warm-up questions from memory, then read the contract
Step 1: split the data and print train and validation accuracy for depths 1 to 6
Step 2: choose the depth with validation, look at the test accuracy once, and match 0.75
Step 3: train on all rows and see 1.0, then read the NotFittedError
Step 4: compare the tree with the baseline and the rule on the test pile and write your conclusion
Play the Model Referee game to the end and see your score
